title: camptosorus rhizophyllus
intro: Camptosorus rhizophyllus, commonly known as Rock Cap or Walking Fern, is a type of small to medium-sized, terrestrial fern native to eastern North America. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Camptosorus rhizophyllus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
